daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position; ﴿فِي لَيْلَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الْقَدْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿وَما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أَدْراكَ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ما, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿ما لَيْلَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; ﴿الْقَدْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause stands in place of the second object of أدراك.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), muḍāf to القدر; ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position; ﴿مِنْ أَلْفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير; ﴿شَهْرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَالرُّوحُ﴾: conjoined to الملائكة; ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: also attached to the verb; ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: attached to the verb; ﴿أَمْرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿سَلامٌ هِيَ﴾: fronted khabar (predicate) and postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive; ﴿حَتَّى مَطْلَعِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سلام; ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
